summary: DeepInfra's DeepStart program grants approximately 50 billion free inference tokens at DeepSeek V4 Flash prices, expiring one year after approval. Eligibility is narrow: the startup must have raised between $250K and $10M USD and been founded within the last 2 years.
claim_steps: Confirm eligibility: raised $250K-$10M USD, founded within the last 2 years.
Apply via the DeepStart page at https://deepinfra.com/deepstart .
On acceptance, credits equivalent to approximately 50 billion tokens at DeepSeek V4 Flash prices expire one year after approval.

social_proof.text: DeepStart ~50,000,000,000 free tokens at DeepSeek V4 Flash prices. Credits expire one year after approval. To qualify: raised between 250K and 10M USD; founded in the last 2 years.
